title: Establish the 90-point release gate
summary: Add unit, integration, E2E, real-audio, recovery, browser, and long-lecture performance evidence required for a 90/100 release.
acceptanceCriteria: Real Mandarin, English, and mixed-language fixtures are versioned or reproducibly generated.
Critical recording-to-notes paths run in automated browser tests.
A 60-minute and a 120-minute workload complete within documented memory and time limits.
Backup and restore are verified against representative data.
Main cannot integrate a task when any required gate fails.
A release checklist records exact versions, environment, SHA, and evidence.
